description: NaSO₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one NaSO₂ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(1), np.int64(0)) direction. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.48 Å. S is bonded in a water-like geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.52 Å) and one longer (1.53 Å) S-O bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Na and one S atom.
